mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_bom WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN 'BOM' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_bom_item WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN 'BOM 子件' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_material_substitute WHERE substitute_id = #{id}) THEN '替代料设置' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_plan WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN '生产计划' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_forecast WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN '销售预测' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_outsource_material WHERE material_id = #{id} OR product_id = #{id}) THEN '委外用料' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_work_order WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN '生产工单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_wo_material WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN '工单用料' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_inspection WHERE material_id = #{id}) THEN '质量检验' END
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_work_order WHERE warehouse_id = #{id}) THEN '生产工单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_wo_doc WHERE warehouse_id = #{id}) THEN '工单领料 / 完工单' END
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_inspection WHERE supplier_id = #{id}) THEN '来料检验' END
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_work_order WHERE create_by = #{id}) THEN '生产工单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_plan WHERE create_by = #{id}) THEN '生产计划' END
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_work_order WHERE dept_id = #{id}) THEN '生产工单' END
